forecast_origin: After the final 5-minute bar of UTC day d; predict complete UTC day d+1
training: Train candidate models on eligible 2025 targets; select hyperparameters by 2026 Q1 log-MSE or Brier. Refit through March 31; freeze coefficients for all final days. Forecast features use data available at each origin, including observed past test days; no final labels used in fitting or tuning.
target: z=log(RV_next_day), RV=sum of squared 5-minute log returns; exp(predicted z) is a positive log-scale forecast, not asserted to be a calibrated conditional arithmetic mean
primary: HAR+All vs HAR on final log-MSE; negative paired loss difference / positive relative reduction favors augmented model
secondary: QLIKE, volatility MAE, nonlinear same-view contrast and high-volatility probability. No selection based on final results.
high_volatility_threshold: 90th percentile of all 2025 daily RV, frozen; this defines a high-volatility day, not a crash
contrast_family: All eight non-HAR regressors versus HAR plus RBF-All versus RBF-HAR; two-sided centered paired-block bootstrap approximate p, Holm across nine comparisons. Primary effect interval reported regardless of significance.
probability_contrast_family: Logit-HAR/Logit-All versus Climatology and Logit-All versus Logit-HAR; Holm across three comparisons
regime_bins: 2025 RV quartiles .25,.5,.9 define descriptive final target regimes; not additional confirmatory tests
missing_rule: Require all 288 valid bars per day and full daily grid. No winsorization, no filled missing data, no removed extreme days. Block inference approximate under dependence/regime change.
publication: Binance Vision attribution and observed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms; raw/full processed market archives local. No trading or causal advantage claims. Existing research packages unchanged.
